questions.question_text: Find the range.
Find the mode.
Find the median.
Find the upper quartile.
Find the inter-quartile range.
Find the mean.
Increase 4.5 kg by 16%.
Find the percentage profit when the cost price of a book is $8.50 and the selling price is $11.05.
The price of a loaf of bread increases by $0.06. This is a 5% increase. Find the original price of this loaf of bread.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for values of x between -3 and 3.
Write down the range of f(x) for -3 <= x <= 0.
On the same diagram, sketch the graph of y = x^2 for -2 <= x <= 2.
Solve the equation 1 / (1 - x^3) = x^2.
The equation 1 / (1 - x^3) = x^2 can be written in the form x^u - x^w + 1 = 0. Find the value of u and the value of w.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle T onto triangle A.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle T onto triangle B.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle T onto triangle C.
Stretch triangle T by a factor of 2 with the y-axis invariant.
Find the value at the end of 4 years. Give your answer correct to the nearest dollar.
Find the value at the start of 2017.
Find the number of complete years it takes for the value of $2025 to decrease to a value less than $500.
Abi rolls the die. Write down the probability that it shows the number 3 on the top.
Beatrice rolls the die and spins the coin. Find the probability that the die shows the number 2 on the top and the coin shows heads.
Find the probability that the die shows the number 2 on the top or the coin shows heads or both.
Carl spins the coin 3 times. Find the probability that the coin shows heads at least once.
Drew rolls the die 3 times and records the numbers on the top. Find the probability that the die shows each of the numbers, 1, 2 and 3, once.
Eva spins the coin n times. The probability that the coin shows tails each time is 1/64. Find the value of n.
Frank rolls the die twice and records the two numbers. The probability of these two numbers occurring is 1/3. Find these two numbers.
Calculate the distance AC and show that your answer rounds to 19.08 km, correct to 2 decimal places.
Using the sine rule, calculate angle ACB and show that your answer rounds to 27.0°, correct to 1 decimal place.
Calculate the bearing of D from C.
A straight path, BP, connects B to the closest point, P, on AC. Calculate the length of this path.
The area within triangle ABC is grassland. Calculate the area of this grassland.
Complete the cumulative frequency curve.
Use your curve to find the inter-quartile range.
Use your curve to estimate the number of people who walked further than 3500 m.
Complete the frequency table.
Calculate an estimate of the mean.
Lionel runs 10.6 km in 94 minutes. Calculate his average speed in km/h.
Monika walks 2 km at a speed of 4 km/h and then 3 km at a speed of 3 km/h. Calculate Monika's overall average speed.
A train is travelling at v metres per second. Find an expression, in terms of v, for the speed of the train in kilometres per hour. Give your answer in its simplest form.
A car travels 50 km at x km/h and then 80 km at (x + 10) km/h. Find an expression, in terms of x, for the total time taken, T hours. Give your answer as a single fraction, in its simplest form.
When T = 2, show that x^2 - 55x - 250 = 0.
When T = 2, find the value of x.
Find f(-2).
Find g(1/2).
Find g(f(1)).
Find x when h(x) = 1/8.
Find j(81).
Find f(f(x)) in its simplest form.
Find f(x) * f(x) + f(x) + 1 in its simplest form.
Find j^(-1)(x).
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x) for 0 <= x <= 180.
Write down the amplitude and the period of f(x).
Solve the inequality f(x) < -1.5 for 0 <= x <= 180.
On the same diagram, sketch the graph of y = g(x) for 0 <= x <= 180.
On the diagram, shade the regions where f(x) >= g(x).
Describe fully the single transformation that maps the graph of y = g(x) onto the graph of y = f(x).
